Bengaluru, India, 25 – 29 August 2025 Agenda Item: 5 Document for: Discussion and decision Introduction The following RAN3 TDoc quota rules are to be maintained (revised from R3-221096) and continue to be the basis for working with TDoc quotas in RAN3. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The TSG RAN WG3 Chair may set a TDoc quota, shown in the heading of an Agenda Item or sub-Agenda Item in the meeting agenda. This indicates the maximum number of contributions that any company may submit to that (sub-)Agenda Item for that meeting. The quota indicated for an Agenda Item applies to the sum of the TDocs submitted to all its sub-Agenda Items unless otherwise specified. RULES AND GUIDELINES FOR TDOC QUOTAS: Complying with the TDoc quota does not guarantee that the contributions will be discussed. If a sourcing company exceeds its TDoc quota for a (sub-)Agenda Item, none of its contributions for that (sub-)Agenda Item will be treated. Response papers count toward the TDoc quota. Contributions from companies count toward the TDoc quota. Co-signed contributions count toward the TDoc quota the first company listed. The following do not count toward the TDoc quota: Rapporteur input (from TS/TR Rapporteur, WI/SI Rapporteur); Pre-agreed input (e.g., baseline CR updates, e-mail discussion reports); Contributions allocated during the meeting (e.g., revisions, summaries of offline discussions, draft LSs/reply LSs); One draft reply LS from the contact company of an incoming LS (LSin); Cat. A CRs submitted together with the corresponding Cat. F CR(s) for corrections, in the appropriate Agenda Item; Late contributions count toward the TDoc quota. h. technical discussion contributions and draft reply LS be submitted sub toward the quota the above quota rules.

3GPP WG3 #114bis-e R3-221096 E-meeting, 17 – 26th Jan 2022 Agenda Item: 5 Document for: Discussion and decision Introduction The following RAN3 quota rules are to be maintained (revised from R3-200133) and continue to be the basis for working with quotas in RAN3. --------------------------------------------------------------8<--------------------------------------------------------------------------- The TSG RAN WG3 Chair may set a Tdoc quota, shown in the heading of an Agenda Item or sub-Agenda Item in the agenda. This indicates the maximum allowed number of contributions that any company may submit to that Agenda Item or sub-agenda Item for that meeting. The quota indicated for an Agenda Item applies to the sum of the Tdocs submitted to all its sub-Agenda Items unless otherwise specified. RULES AND GUIDELINES FOR QUOTAS: Complying with the quota does not guarantee that the contributions will be discussed. If a sourcing company exceeds its quota for an Agenda Item or sub-Agenda Item, none of its contributions for that Agenda Item or sub-Agenda Item will be treated. Response papers count toward the Tdoc quota. Contributions from subsidiaries and controlled companies count toward the Tdoc quota for the controlling company. Co-signed contributions – If the contribution is signed by 2 companies, it counts toward the Tdoc quota for the first company listed. If it is signed by 3 or more companies, it does not count toward the Tdoc quota for any company. Subsidiaries and controlled companies are not counted as additional co-signers for the purpose of Tdoc quotas. Tdoc Quota: Maximum allowed number of Tdocs for any company. This is set by the RAN3 Chairman for submission towards an Agenda Item or Sub-Agenda Item. It is indicated in the Chairman's Notes in the heading of each Agenda Item or Sub-Agenda Item. The quota indicated in an Agenda Item applies to the sum of the Tdocs submitted to all its sub-Agenda Items unless otherwise specified; this is to allow the freedom to prioritize which sub-topics to contribute to. Meeting the Tdoc quota does not guarantee that the Tdocs will be treated. If a sourcing company exceeds its quota for an AI, none of its contributions for that AI will be treated. (This limit is to be taken very seriously. The aim is to limit the available "ammunition", in order for companies to prioritize their "targets" and to make the meeting more efficient.) Response papers count toward the Tdoc quota. The following does not count toward the Tdoc quota: Rapporteur input (TS/TR Rapporteur, WI/SI Rapporteur); Pre-agreed input (BL CR updates, e-mail discussion reports, etc.); Contributions allocated during the meeting (revisions, summaries of offline discussion, draft LSs/reply LSs, etc.); One Draft Reply LS from the contact company of an incoming LS. (This ensures that the spirit of good cooperation in RAN3 stays the same.) Late contributions submitted during the meeting, which do not fall into these 4 categories, count toward the Tdoc quota. Co-signed contributions – If the contribution is signed by 2 companies, it counts toward the Tdoc quota for the first company listed. If it is signed by 3 or more companies, it does not count toward the Tdoc quota for any company. For corrections to previous and current releases (i.e. Cat. F CRs and companion discussion paper submitted to AIs 9.x and 31.x), if there are 2 sourcing companies and at least one of them is an operator, the contribution does not count toward

This number applies to the sum of the Tdocs submitted to all the sub-Agenda Items. If e.g. QUOTA: 5 appears in AI 10.x, a company may submit up to 5 contributions to AI 10.x in any combination: e.g. up to 4 to 10.x.1.1 and up to 1 to 10.x.1.2, or up to 3 to 10.x.1.1 and up to 2 to 10.x.1.2, and so on. Please see also at the end of this document. Quota rules are to be maintained R3-221096 (revised from R3-200133) and continue to be the basis for working with quotas in RAN3. Some suggestions for better RAN3 meetings can also be found here.
